_comment: Import: Admin → Nests → Import Egg. Build product image: deploy/image/Dockerfile (ADR §68).
name: Zenith Bedrock
author: diegosantosaraujo@outlook.com
description: Zenith — layered C# Bedrock server (protocol 1001). Same product image as Compose. Config: zenith.yml under /home/container (ZENITH_DATA).

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Zenith install — seeds shared deploy/zenith.yml; binary is in the product image.
set -e
cd /mnt/server
mkdir -p worlds
if [ ! -f zenith.yml ]; then
  curl -fsSL -o zenith.yml https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zenith-bedrock/zenith/develop/deploy/zenith.yml
fi
echo "Installation complete"
